tool_args.rationale: The paid rows identify the subcritical response but leave the supercritical branch untested. With no dedicated high-gradient probe on the menu, the trajectory batch is the remaining candidate for measurements above s_grad = 2.68. More samples below the threshold would not resolve the ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit and confirm the subcritical law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It fits all seven rows to rounding precision, but it cannot distinguish a smooth continuation from a supercritical drop.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the full avalanche law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All measured gradients lie below the candidate threshold, so neither the threshold nor the avalanche strength can be estimated.
This probe was already acquired and reached only s_grad = 2.35, below the candidate threshold.
